description: This Java class 'FinancialActivityAccountDataValidator' performs validation of JSON input data for creating and updating financial activity account records in the Fineract accounting module. It checks for required parameters, valid values, and unsupported parameters.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountDataValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates JSON data for creating and updating financial activity accounts, ensuring parameters are supported, present, and have valid values.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a financial activity account, checking required parameters and their values.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a financial activity account, allowing optional parameters.

methods.name: validateJSONAndCheckForUnsupportedParams
methods.description: Checks if JSON is blank or contains unsupported parameters.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if validation errors are present.

methods.name: getDataValidator
methods.description: Creates and returns a DataValidatorBuilder instance for validation.
